snippet.title: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! | Announcement Trailer | Day of the Devs Summer Game Fest Edition 2026
snippet.description:
Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! is a slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and noodly arms to the max! 

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564410
Coming to PC and console in 2027.

Our world is broken... but at Puzzl, we're putting it back together piece by piece - better than before! Join our team of PuzzPals and help us solve the world's problems with a personal touch.

Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets, and lean on the skills you’ve learned from point-and-clicks to SLAP-AND-SOLVE. Travel between floors, gather items in your fanny pack, and take your lateral thinking to new heights as you unravel how every room and their inhabitants are connected. Everything within reach of your stretchy arms is satisfyingly interactive and responsive to your touch with animation, sound, and haptics. Every background detail is intentional and worthy of your attention - so explore and slap everything, because you never know what might happen.

Slap Out Of It! is inspired and adapted from the hit "Floor Plan" VR escape game series. It is dramatically expanded with all-new gameplay and secrets to discover. Please note this is not a VR game and does not support VR. 

🗣️ Trailer narrated by Ben Starr
🎵 Music by Sean Beeson
❤️ Developed with love by Turbo Button
